name: B10-0403/2026 (Renew) – Political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Cuba to release everyone held for political reasons, especially Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro. It condemns torture and poor treatment in Cuban prisons and demands fair trials, access to lawyers and medical care. It also asks European Union countries to sanction Cuban officials responsible for human rights abuses and to consider suspending the European Union's cooperation agreement with Cuba. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing directly. The Parliament asks the European Union to sanction Cuban officials and review its Cuba agreement.
- **Who it affects:** Cuba's government, political prisoners including the Navarro father and daughter, and European Union relations with Cuba.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and other bodies. Whether sanctions or a suspension follow is up to them.
